title: Archive Helper — remove inbound links (parameters, batched)
description: Paste into Contentful App Action 'parametersSchema' (JSON Schema draft-04). One invocation processes at most batchSize linking entries; repeat with nextSkip until hasMore is false.

targetEntryId.description: Entry whose inbound references should be removed or previewed.

batchSize.description: Max linking entries to fetch from CMA in this invocation (default 20; installation default if omitted).

skip.description: Offset into the CMA links_to_entry ordering for this batch.

dryRun.description: When true, compute changes only; do not persist updates.

publishStrategy.description: none: draft update only; republish-if-published: publish entries that were already published.

localeMode.description: Which locales to scan when removing references.

contentTypeFilter.description: If set, only process linking entries whose content type id is in this list.
